files.title: File:U.S. Coast Guard Cutter Mackinaw (WLBB-30) Docked at the Main Pier of the Ellwood A. Mattson Lower Harbor Park.jpg
files.author: Steven Fine
files.caption: The U.S. Coast Guard Cutter Mackinaw (WLBB-30) docked at the main pier of the Ellwood A. Mattson Lower Harbor Park in Marquette, Michigan. The Mackinaw breaks ice in the Great Lakes, services buoys, and supports other Coast Guard activities.
